verdict.rationale: Pigment documents its own button-driven scenario runs and a projected year-end cash KPI in budget planning, so the building blocks of scenario-level cash projection are first-party features. Nothing in the evidence shows burn or runway being computed per scenario, or a zero-cash date that moves between scenarios. missing for 10: explicit per-scenario burn and runway calculation, zero-cash date output, side-by-side scenario cash comparison, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, burn and cash runway are computed per scenario, so I can see how a decision moves the zero-cash date

citations.quote: Run scenarios at the touch of a button to assess different assumptions
you can also set up KPI. For example, as we have here, projected year end cash.
